items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: Like Seth David. For instance. He mixed a bunch of sessions.

ctx.x: Rocket movies. Called. Yeah. Go Jimmy Go. I think Hal Roach produced it. Yeah. And this one. Ship on Stormy Sea. Was Clanton Mitassa. David. And Rabinac. Were the writers.

Well Seth and Mac. Seth and Mac. Rode a lot together.
